variants.headline: Still in view: union calls a strike
variants.sub: A strike has been called by the union {name}.
variants.body:
The union {name} has called a strike. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

Our movement believes a political principle should have something to say about the people who do the work. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: Still in view: a call to withhold labour
variants.sub: The union {name} has issued a call for strike action.
variants.body:
A strike has been called by the union {name}. This story remains under examination, {months_running} months into our coverage of the original event.

Our movement believes a political principle should have something to say about the people who do the work. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: Still in view: work becomes the subject of a strike call
variants.sub: The union {name} has called a strike.
variants.body:
The union {name} has issued a call for strike action. Our attention to this story continues after {months_running} months, with the original report still the starting point.

Our movement believes a political principle should have something to say about the people who do the work. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.
